false_positives.comment: Reviewed against wxnotepad revision b015dda89776e3dda74f093e9656d36792143a7e. CompareNoCase in src/editor/word_completion.cpp is the ASCII-insensitive alternative in WordList::WL_strncmp, declared int (*)(const char*, const char*, size_t). WordList::Init assigns CompareNoCase when ignoreCase is enabled and standard strncmp otherwise; StartsWith invokes the same callback. The pointer/count signature provides direct compatibility with strncmp. The count is a maximum string comparison bound and the implementation also stops at NUL, rather than describing a required span extent. Replacing this signature with std::span would break the comparator callback contract. The reported parameter is therefore intentional.

transition.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against wxnotepad revision b015dda89776e3dda74f093e9656d36792143a7e. S1000 concerns unnamed namespaces in shared headers. Here the namespace is in the production word_completion.cpp implementation and intentionally isolates CharBuffer, WordList, Collector and comparison helpers. tests/completion_allocation.cpp explicitly includes this implementation to exercise the actual private candidate storage in its own translation unit. CMake builds editor_features as a static library and a separate completion_allocation executable; the included implementation supplies CompleteWord for the test. The public word_completion.h has the named option namespaces and external declarations. No cross-translation-unit identity or shared state is expected from these private entities. Naming this implementation namespace would alter its intentional translation-unit isolation; this finding results from intentional test-only source inclusion.

transition.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against wxnotepad revision b015dda89776e3dda74f093e9656d36792143a7e. AppLocalization::SetAccessibleName(wxWindow&, ...) mutates native accessibility state. The supported __WXMSW__ branch calls window.SetAccessible(new NamedWindowAccessible(name)); in pinned wxWidgets 3.3.3 this is a non-const method, deleting the old m_accessible, assigning the replacement and attaching the window. Declaration: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/include/wx/window.h (SetAccessible); implementation: https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/blob/v3.3.3/src/common/wincmn.cpp (wxWindowBase::SetAccessible). The GTK path also writes the native accessible name through atk_object_set_name. Linux compilation analysis does not see the Windows non-const call. Changing wxWindow& to const wxWindow& would break the supported Windows implementation, so the mutable parameter is required.

transition.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against wxnotepad revision b015dda89776e3dda74f093e9656d36792143a7e. tests/zoom.cpp NativeKey intentionally sends keyboard input to the supplied EditorControl. On Windows SendMessageW targets editor->GetHandle(); on GTK gtk_widget_event targets editor->GetConnectWidget() and its drawing window. editor_control.cpp binds wxEVT_KEY_DOWN to OnKeyDown, which routes editing/navigation and HandleApplicationKey to actual zoom commands. CheckZoom asserts the target editor's zoom changed after these calls. Const-qualified native handle accessors hide the indirect mutation from parameter analysis. The input helper requires a mutable editor because the dispatched operation changes that same editor.

transition.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against wxnotepad revision b015dda89776e3dda74f093e9656d36792143a7e. tests/zoom.cpp NativeWheel intentionally delivers Ctrl+wheel input to the supplied EditorControl via SendMessageW(WM_MOUSEWHEEL) or gtk_widget_event(GDK_SCROLL). editor_control.cpp binds the native wheel event to OnMouse; Core::Wheel updates the editor's physical-wheel accumulator and invokes window_.Send(ZoomIn/ZoomOut). The following CheckZoom assertion verifies the editor changed to 110 percent. Native handles are obtained through const-qualified accessors but the dispatched operation mutates the target editor, so making this input helper's editor parameter const would misrepresent its mutation contract.

transition.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against wxnotepad revision b015dda89776e3dda74f093e9656d36792143a7e. tests/zoom.cpp Menu constructs a wxEVT_MENU and dispatches it through frame->GetEventHandler()->ProcessEvent. The bound frame menu handlers execute zoom changes on its editor or create the owned Zoom Level dialog. This is an input/command operation on the frame's event-processing state and owned UI, with subsequent assertions checking changed zoom. GetEventHandler() exposes a mutable event handler through a const accessor; that indirect dispatch explains the analyzer's missed mutation. Retain the mutable frame parameter for the command helper.

transition.message: The issue status was successfully changed.

false_positives.comment: Reviewed against wxnotepad revision b015dda89776e3dda74f093e9656d36792143a7e. This dict consumes two-element key/value sequences returned by line.split("=", 1) while parsing xdotool --shell geometry. SonarSource's own pinned rule fixture explicitly labels the equivalent dict(x.split("=") for x in update_str.split(",")) pattern as FP SONARPY-3154: https://github.com/SonarSource/sonar-python/blob/9ae0129e3f7b41be37b3b128e4b6447b467c278a/python-checks/src/test/resources/checks/rewriteCollectionConstructorAsComprehension.py (lines 48-49). Adding an outer {key: value for key, value in (...)} would only copy the pairs and introduce the redundant-comprehension pattern described by S7500. Keep the existing split-on-first-equals parsing, including duplicate-key and malformed-line behavior. This key is the move-peer geometry parser.

transition.message: The issue status was successfully changed.
